text: The Internet of Things engineering focuses on "interconnection of things, data sharing, and intelligent decision-making", aiming to explore how to achieve the integration of the "physical world and digital world" through the collaboration of the perception layer (sensors, devices), the network layer (communication technologies), and the application layer (data analysis and control). Its core objective is to break the isolated state of traditional devices, enabling various objects (such as household appliances, automobiles, industrial machinery, urban facilities, etc.) to possess the ability to "communicate and connect online", ultimately realizing application values such as efficient management, energy conservation and consumption reduction, and convenient life.
